entries.text: You see a mad scientist. He is working diligently on something.
entries.source_text: You see a mad scientist. He is working diligently on something.

entries.text: Good evening, brother. What brings you to our little corner of heaven?
entries.source_text: Good evening, brother. What brings you to our little corner of heaven?

entries.text: Good evening, sister. What brings you to our little corner of heaven?
entries.source_text: Good evening, sister. What brings you to our little corner of heaven?

entries.text: I'm here to check on your progress.
entries.source_text: I'm here to check on your progress.

entries.text: What might you be doing here?
entries.source_text: What might you be doing here?

entries.text: What?! You dare question me? How about I experiment on your brain, you twisted skag?!
entries.source_text:
What?! You dare question me? How about I experiment on your brain,
 you twisted skag?!

entries.text: Gack.
entries.source_text: Gack.

entries.text: You, again? And why are you disturbing the Master's glorious future this time?
entries.source_text:
You, again? And why are you disturbing the Master's glorious
 future this time?

entries.text: The Master grows impatient with your failures, and I with your impudence!
entries.source_text:
The Master grows impatient with your failures, and I with your
 impudence!

entries.text: I want to know what's happening with your experiments.
entries.source_text: I want to know what's happening with your experiments.

entries.text: That's it, I'm putting an end to YOUR future right here and now, chump!
entries.source_text: That's it, I'm putting an end to YOUR future right here and now, chump!

entries.text: Oofah!
entries.source_text: Oofah!

entries.text: It's not going well. I've been injecting the FEV directly into the pineal gland, but I'm not getting the results I'd hoped for.
entries.source_text:
It's not going well. I've been injecting the FEV directly into the
 pineal gland, but I'm not getting the results I'd hoped for.

entries.text: Why don't you try injecting it directly into the Amygdala?
entries.source_text: Why don't you try injecting it directly into the Amygdala?

entries.text: Why don't you try injecting it into the Medula?
entries.source_text: Why don't you try injecting it into the Medula?

entries.text: What results are you getting?
entries.source_text: What results are you getting?

entries.text: Hmmm. And?
entries.source_text: Hmmm. And?

entries.text: I beg your forgiveness, sir. How may I be of service?
entries.source_text: I beg your forgiveness, sir. How may I be of service?

entries.text: I beg your forgiveness, ma'am. How may I be of service?
entries.source_text: I beg your forgiveness, ma'am. How may I be of service?

entries.text: You can speak to me with respect next time, or you'll never speak to anyone again!
entries.source_text:
You can speak to me with respect next time, or you'll never speak to
 anyone again!

entries.text: The Master's truth is revealed, resulting in increased psychic ability. [shakes his head] But the poor souls become terminally insane and must be sequestered and nullified to keep them from harming themselves or others.
entries.source_text:
The Master's truth is revealed, resulting in increased psychic
 ability. [shakes his head] But the poor souls become terminally insane and
 must be sequestered and nullified to keep them from harming themselves or
 others.

entries.text: Oh, how thoughtful of you...
entries.source_text: Oh, how thoughtful of you...

entries.text: Where are they being kept?
entries.source_text: Where are they being kept?

entries.text: You heartless butcher! I think I'll nullify your brain and sequester it from the rest of your body! Die, you bastard!
entries.source_text:
You heartless butcher! I think I'll nullify your brain and sequester
 it from the rest of your body! Die, you bastard!

entries.text: In a room northwest of here. Is there anything else I can help you with?
entries.source_text: In a room northwest of here. Is there anything else I can help you with?

entries.text: Thank you for your help. Bye.
entries.source_text: Thank you for your help. Bye.

entries.text: Yeah, uh. What's FEV?
entries.source_text: Yeah, uh. What's FEV?

entries.text: You can die!
entries.source_text: You can die!

entries.text: I have no time for your tomfoolery!
entries.source_text: I have no time for your tomfoolery!

entries.text: What an intriguing idea! I must try it at once!
entries.source_text: What an intriguing idea! I must try it at once!

entries.text: Uh, where are you keeping the failed experiments?
entries.source_text: Uh, where are you keeping the failed experiments?

entries.text: Don't mention it.
entries.source_text: Don't mention it.

entries.text: Yeah! Let's try it on you!
entries.source_text: Yeah! Let's try it on you!

entries.text: Vincent! Prepare our newest volunteer!
entries.source_text: Vincent! Prepare our newest volunteer!

entries.text: What? That's the most ludicrous thing I've ever heard! [looks at you suspiciously] Who are you, really?
entries.source_text:
What? That's the most ludicrous thing I've ever heard! [looks at
 you suspiciously] Who are you, really?

entries.text: Oh, sorry. I've got to go now.
entries.source_text: Oh, sorry. I've got to go now.

entries.text: I'm a new..uh...guy.... I've been sent to find out how you are doing.
entries.source_text: I'm a new..uh...guy.... I've been sent to find out how you are doing.

entries.text: I already told you, I've been sent by the Master to check up on you.
entries.source_text: I already told you, I've been sent by the Master to check up on you.

entries.text: I've come to remove your spleen... without anesthetic!
entries.source_text: I've come to remove your spleen... without anesthetic!

entries.text: Alright, then. So how is it going?
entries.source_text: Alright, then. So how is it going?

entries.text: Your attitude has told me all I need to know. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: Your attitude has told me all I need to know. Goodbye.

entries.text: Ah ha! An interloper! Just as I suspected. Vincent!
entries.source_text: Ah ha! An interloper! Just as I suspected. Vincent!

entries.text: Who are you? And why are you wearing that suit? [to himself] I haven't seen one of those in a long time.
entries.source_text:
Who are you? And why are you wearing that suit? [to himself] I haven't
 seen one of those in a long time.

entries.text: I'm in disguise. Intruders have infiltrated the Master's sanctuary, and I'm dressed like one of them to gain their confidence.
entries.source_text:
I'm in disguise. Intruders have infiltrated the Master's sanctuary,
 and I'm dressed like one of them to gain their confidence.

entries.text: How dare you question one of the Master's special operatives!
entries.source_text: How dare you question one of the Master's special operatives!

entries.text: When have you seen a suit like this before?
entries.source_text: When have you seen a suit like this before?

entries.text: It's extruded rubber, so it's real easy to wipe your blood off after I kill you!
entries.source_text:
It's extruded rubber, so it's real easy to wipe your blood off after
 I kill you!

entries.text: Oh, you know, when we got that last batch of pure-strain humans in... I think there is still one in the holding pens. Why do you ask?
entries.source_text:
Oh, you know, when we got that last batch of pure-strain humans in...
 I think there is still one in the holding pens. Why do you ask?

entries.text: No reason. How are the experiments going?
entries.source_text: No reason. How are the experiments going?

entries.text: I've got to report back to the Master. I don't have time for this.
entries.source_text: I've got to report back to the Master. I don't have time for this.

entries.text: [shakes his head] Alas, the poor souls become terminally insane and must be sequestered and nullified to keep them from harming themselves or others.
entries.source_text:
[shakes his head] Alas, the poor souls become terminally insane and
 must be sequestered and nullified to keep them from harming themselves or
 others.

entries.text: Oh, how thoughtful of you...
entries.source_text: Oh, how thoughtful of you...

entries.text: You heartless bastard! I think I'll nullify your brain and sequester it from the rest of your body! Die, you bastard!
entries.source_text:
You heartless bastard! I think I'll nullify your brain and sequester
 it from the rest of your body! Die, you bastard!

entries.text: You see Vincent, a super mutant guard. He looks bored.
entries.source_text: You see Vincent, a super mutant guard. He looks bored.

entries.text: You see a super mutant, obviously guarding the scientists. He looks bored
entries.source_text:
You see a super mutant, obviously guarding the scientists. He looks
 bored

entries.text: Intruders!
entries.source_text: Intruders!

entries.text: I'm just watching the mads. Don't talk to me.
entries.source_text: I'm just watching the mads. Don't talk to me.

entries.text: Leave me alone.
entries.source_text: Leave me alone.

entries.text: You see a sleeping mad scientist.
entries.source_text: You see a sleeping mad scientist.

entries.text: Zzzzzz
entries.source_text: Zzzzzz

entries.text: Huh! What? [rubs eyes] Vincent, remove this heathen from our chambers!
entries.source_text: Huh! What? [rubs eyes] Vincent, remove this heathen from our chambers!

entries.text: Huh? [snort] ...zzzzzzzzz
entries.source_text: Huh? [snort] ...zzzzzzzzz

entries.text: You see Vincent. He is guarding the sleeping mads.
entries.source_text: You see Vincent. He is guarding the sleeping mads.

entries.text: You see a super mutant guard. He is nearly standing over the prone bodies.
entries.source_text: You see a super mutant guard. He is nearly standing over the prone bodies.

entries.text: Leave them alone, and get out. No one is allowed in here while they are sleeping.
entries.source_text:
Leave them alone, and get out. No one is allowed in here while they
 are sleeping.

entries.text: You again! I told you to leave the scientists alone!
entries.source_text: You again! I told you to leave the scientists alone!

entries.text: You have overstayed your welcome.
entries.source_text: You have overstayed your welcome.
